description: The same call passing `@sig`, a machine-bound reactive. Isolates the target-shape condition from the `replay` builtin.
rationale: §51.14 — `replay(@target, @log)` re-applies recorded transition entries to a machine-governed reactive. The first argument must be an `@`-ref to a machine-bound reactive, because replay commits VARIANT values through that machine's rule set; a non-reactive first argument has no variant domain to replay into.
